title: 第7章 对方撤回一条消息
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这雨下得真够可以的！眼看两步就到家了！”

李安国骂骂咧咧

换了双拖鞋就往厕所冲。

打算先拿一条毛巾给念念擦一擦。

小人儿被雨浇透，浑身上下都淌着水。

滴在地上形成一个小小的水洼。

看见李安国家是木地板。

想都没想就缩回脚，乖乖站在门外。

李安国回来的时候没有见到孩子。

正疑惑呢。

就瞧见门还没有关。

念念正歪着半个脑袋，扒在门框上偷看。

“念念，干嘛呢？进来啊！”

念念看了一眼地板，有些紧张，“不，不用了，我身上都是水，会把地板弄坏的。”

李安国哭笑不得，直接伸手将她拉了进来。

毛巾盖头，一顿乱搓。

“没事，木地板没你想的那么金贵，一点水而已，又不是家被淹了，不会有事的。”

念念被搓得左摇右晃。

整个人晕乎乎，李安国的话一个字都没听进去。

“不行啊，太湿了，你这样会感冒的，我先抱你去浴室洗个澡，换一身干净衣服。”

话音刚落，念念就感觉自己双脚离地。

一阵天旋地转后。

头上的毛巾被人拿开。

入眼就是一整面墙的白瓷砖。

窗边摆放着瓶瓶罐罐。

“会洗澡吗？”

李安国将花洒塞到她手里，简单教了一下冷热的方向，便转身离开。

念念刚张开嘴想说话，就见李安国已经关上了门。

不喜欢麻烦别人的小人儿，只能将话憋了回去，默默捣鼓。

“这边是冷……这边是热……”

李安国听到浴室里传来水声。

拿了一件背心放在浴室外面给念念当睡衣后，便下楼去给念念置办牙刷和拖鞋。

“阿秋！”

十分钟后。

念念眼神幽怨地看了一眼花洒。

什么这边热那边冷，明明全都是冷的！

还不如烧桶水呢！

她擦干水珠，穿好李安国给她准备的背心。

拖着长长的衣摆就站在卫生间门口张望。

房子两室一厅一厨一卫。

卧室在卫生间左右各一间。

左边的卧室没有关门。

念念歪着脑袋一看，就能看到里面的全部布局。

四面大白墙加一张床。

家具非常简陋。

但在念念眼里，却是不可多得的好住处！

Page (1/3)

"It's raining really well! We're home in just two steps!"

Li Anguo cursed

I changed into a pair of slippers and flushed to the toilet.

I plan to take a towel and wipe it with Niannian first.

The little man was soaked by the rain, with water dripping all over his body.

The drops formed a small puddle on the ground.

I saw that Ang Lee's country had wooden floors.

Without thinking, he retracted his feet and stood outside the door obediently.

Li Anguo did not see the child when he came back.

Just wondering.

I saw that the door was not closed yet.

Nian Nian was tilting half of her head, leaning on the door frame to peek.

"Nian Nian, what are you doing? Come in!"

Nian Nian glanced at the floor, a little nervous, "No, no need, I'm covered in water and it will damage the floor."

Li Anguo didn't know whether to laugh or cry, and stretched out his hand to pull her in.

Cover your head with a towel and rub it all over.

"It's okay. The wooden floor is not as valuable as you think. It's just a little water. It's not like the house was flooded. It'll be fine."

Niannian was shaken from side to side.

He was so dizzy that he didn't listen to a word Li Anguo said.

"No, it's too wet. You'll catch a cold. I'll take you to the bathroom to take a bath and change into clean clothes."

As soon as she finished speaking, Nian Nian felt her feet leave the ground.

After a while, the world was spinning.

The towel on the head was taken away.

The first thing you see is a whole wall of white ceramic tiles.

Bottles and cans were placed by the window.

"Can you take a bath?"

Li Anguo put the showerhead into her hand, briefly taught her the directions of hot and cold, then turned and left.

As soon as Niannian opened her mouth to speak, she saw that Li Anguo had already closed the door.

I don't like to trouble others, so I can only hold back my words and make trouble silently.

"It's cold here...it's hot here..."

Li Anguo heard the sound of water coming from the bathroom.

After taking a vest and putting it outside the bathroom as pajamas for Nian Nian, I went downstairs to buy a toothbrush and slippers for Nian Nian.

"Aqiu!"

Ten minutes later.

Nian Nian glanced at the shower head with resentful eyes.

It's hot here and cold there, but they're all cold!

Might as well boil a bucket of water!

She wiped off the water drops and put on the vest Li Anguo prepared for her.

Dragging his long clothes, he stood at the bathroom door and looked around.

The house has two bedrooms, one living room, one kitchen and one bathroom.

There are one bedroom on each side of the bathroom.

The bedroom on the left has no door.

Nian Nian tilted her head and took a look, and she could see the entire layout inside.

Four large white walls and a bed.

The furniture is very basic.

But in Nian Nian's eyes, it is a rare and good place to live!
